falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the 200-day moving average by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a strong bullish trend contradicting the 'HOLD' signal, suggesting the UNKNOWN verdict is incorrect as a clear directional move has emerged.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume on at least 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a spike in volume would signal a blowoff top or extreme market stress, directly contradicting the 'HOLD' and proving the UNKNOWN verdict is invalid due to a clear market event.

falsification_conditions.condition: The CBOE VIX index rises above 30 (a threshold indicating extreme fear) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A VIX spike above 30 would indicate a market crash risk, invalidating the 'HOLD' by showing a clear bearish catalyst that the UNKNOWN verdict failed to anticipate.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
